title: Uniqueness of computed output
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine and $O$ an oracle language. If on the same input $x$, the machine halts with output $w$ after $t$ steps and halts with output $w'$ after $t'$ steps, both relative to $O$, then $w=w'$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of ordinary work tapes
A state type and symbol type
A time $t$ at which $M$ halts with output $w$
A time $t'$ at which $M$ halts with output $w'$
